purpose: Skip-and-fill 30-record pilot batch 101: thirty independently source-verified 3.5-era reference records selected from a broad queue scan; risky legacy, unresolved, or insufficiently verified candidates were skipped rather than capping the batch.

spells/fleshbound-4797.name: Fleshbound
spells/fleshbound-4797.effectSummary: A possessing spirit in the touched creature is bound to that host and has complete control over the host while the spell lasts. Each round, as a full-round action, the possessed creature can attempt a special Will save whose DC is the Fleshbound save DC minus the possessing spirit's Hit Dice plus your caster level; a quori possessing an Inspired host adds the host's levels to its Hit Dice for this calculation. On a successful save the spirit can abandon the host as a free action; if it remains, it stays bound. Hit point damage or ability damage dealt to the host also damages the spirit, although the spirit cannot be killed by this transferred damage. If either the host or spirit reaches 0 or fewer hit points, the spirit is forced out as if by dismissal and cannot possess another host for a number of days equal to the total hit point and ability damage dealt to it through the host. Material component: a small sphere of volcanic glass.
spells/fleshbound-4797.notes: Secrets of Sarlona printing, digest-locked. The spell's forced-ejection clause explicitly invokes dismissal, but its possession-binding, save formula, damage transfer, and post-ejection lockout are printed directly here.

provenance.role: primary Secrets of Sarlona catalog record and digest source
Player's Handbook v.3.5 reference for the explicitly invoked forced dismissal

spells/heart-of-air-876.name: Heart of Air
spells/heart-of-air-876.effectSummary: For 1 hour/level you gain a +10 enhancement bonus on Jump checks and, if you already have a fly speed, a +10-foot enhancement bonus to that speed. At any time during the duration you can activate a feather fall effect on yourself as an immediate action; that effect lasts 1 round/level, after which Heart of Air ends. While at least one other heart spell from the same series is active, you gain light fortification, giving a 25% chance to negate extra damage from critical hits or sneak attacks; with all four heart spells active, you are instead immune to that extra damage. The feather-fall activation reduces your falling speed to 60 feet per round and prevents falling damage while it remains active.
spells/heart-of-air-876.notes: Complete Mage printing, digest-locked. Feather Fall is expanded only for the spell's immediate-action release mode; the Jump, fly-speed, fortification, and four-heart synergy are source-specific.

provenance.role: primary Complete Mage catalog record and digest source
Player's Handbook v.3.5 source for the explicitly inherited feather-fall effect

spells/lawful-sword-2254.name: Lawful Sword
spells/lawful-sword-2254.effectSummary: One melee weapon you touch becomes a +5 axiomatic weapon for 1 round/level: it is lawful-aligned and deals +2d6 damage against chaotic creatures. It also continuously projects a magic circle against chaos. That 10-foot protective aura gives affected creatures +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against attacks or effects from chaotic creatures, suppresses possession and mental control while the protection applies, and prevents bodily contact by chaotic summoned creatures subject to the normal protection-circle limitations. If the circle is ended while the weapon remains under Lawful Sword, the weapon recreates it as a free action on your turn. The spell ends 1 round after the weapon leaves your hand; you can have only one Lawful Sword at a time. Its granted weapon properties supersede the weapon's normal enhancement bonus and special abilities for the duration, do not stack with other weapon-modifying spells, and do not affect artifacts.
spells/lawful-sword-2254.notes: Player's Guide to Faerûn printing, digest-locked. This spell follows Holy Sword's weapon-transformation chassis but substitutes axiomatic/lawful properties and Magic Circle against Chaos.

spells/reduce-animal-2859.name: Reduce Animal
spells/reduce-animal-2859.effectSummary: A willing Small, Medium, Large, or Huge animal is reduced by one size category for 1 hour/level. It gains +2 Dexterity, takes -2 Strength to a minimum Strength of 1, and gains +1 on attack rolls and AC from reduced size. Its height and length are halved and weight becomes one-eighth; space, reach, natural-weapon and weapon damage change for the new size, while speed does not change. Worn and carried equipment shrinks with the animal; an item that leaves its possession returns to normal size, while a projectile returns to normal after striking. Multiple magical size reductions do not stack. The subject's adjusted natural-attack damage follows the standard size-change damage progression.
spells/reduce-animal-2859.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Reduce Person supplies the explicit reduction mechanics; Reduce Animal changes the eligible target to one willing animal and its duration.

spells/opalescent-glare-2192.effectSummary: You fix one living creature within 60 feet with an opalescent glare. An evil creature with 5 or fewer Hit Dice that fails its Will save dies; even if it succeeds, it is affected as by fear for 2d10 rounds. A nonevil creature, or an evil creature with more than 5 Hit Dice, suffers only the fear effect on a failed Will save. The inherited fear effect makes the victim panicked, causing it to flee at top speed and cower if unable to escape, subject to the normal fear rules.

spells/phantom-stag-4628.name: Phantom Stag
spells/phantom-stag-4628.effectSummary: Creates a Large magical stag mount with AC 20 (-1 size, +6 natural, +5 Dexterity), 40 hit points plus 5 per caster level, and an antler attack at +10 dealing 1d8+9 damage, doubled on a charge. It can trample Medium or smaller creatures for 1d6+9 damage; the Spell Compendium printing gives a Reflex save DC of 18 + one-half your caster level. Its speed is 20 feet per caster level, maximum 300 feet, it can carry its rider plus 10 pounds per caster level, and it ignores terrain that would normally slow movement. At caster level 12 it can air walk for at most 1 round at a time and gains +2 deflection AC; at 14 it can fly with average maneuverability and gains +4; at 16 its antlers gain ghost touch and wounding and it gains +6; at 18 it can use etherealness for itself and rider as an 18th-level caster and gains +8 deflection AC.

spells/polymorph-2854.name: Polymorph
spells/polymorph-2854.effectSummary: A willing living creature assumes the form of an aberration, animal, dragon, fey, giant, humanoid, magical beast, monstrous humanoid, ooze, plant, or vermin. The assumed form can have no more Hit Dice than the lower of your caster level or the subject's Hit Dice, to a maximum of 15 HD; it cannot be smaller than Fine and cannot be incorporeal or gaseous. Type and subtype change to match the form. The subject gains the new form's Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, size, movement modes, natural armor, natural weapons, racial skill bonuses, racial bonus feats, and extraordinary special attacks, but not its extraordinary special qualities, supernatural abilities, or spell-like abilities; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma are retained. Equipment changes and spellcasting/body limitations follow alter self. The transformation heals lost hit points as though the subject had rested for a night, but does not restore ability damage or provide other rest benefits. If killed, the subject reverts but remains dead. Templates cannot be assumed.
spells/polymorph-2854.notes: Player's Handbook v.3.5 printing, digest-locked. Alter Self supplies the equipment, body, movement, natural-armor, natural-weapon, and casting chassis; Polymorph's broader creature types, HD cap, physical scores, healing, and extraordinary-attack rules are preserved directly.

same-book source for inherited transformation mechanics

spells/shadow-of-the-dark-queen-1111.name: Shadow of the Dark Queen
spells/shadow-of-the-dark-queen-1111.effectSummary: A touched object radiates a 60-foot area of shadowy illumination for 2 rounds/level, using deeper darkness's illumination model; evil dragons and creatures with the dragonblood subtype can see normally within it. The area also functions as desecrate: turning checks against undead take -3, undead gain +1 profane on attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves, and undead created or summoned there gain +1 hit point per Hit Die. If the object is a permanent fixture dedicated to an evil power, those modifiers double and animate dead capacity is doubled; a fixture dedicated to a hostile power instead severs the effect's connection. A good dragon or dragonblood creature must succeed on a Will save to enter; once inside, each round it takes 2d6 damage and is dazed, with a successful Will save halving the damage and negating the daze. The spell counters or dispels Light of Xymor and equal-or-lower light effects as specified by its darkness inheritance. Divine spellcasters devoted to Tiamat cast it at +1 caster level.

spells/symbol-of-insanity-2575.name: Symbol of Insanity
spells/symbol-of-insanity-2575.effectSummary: Creates a permanent magical rune using symbol of death's placement, detection, trigger, password, attunement, dispelling, and offensive-use restrictions, but with no Hit Dice cap. Once triggered it remains active for 10 minutes per caster level. Creatures that fail the Will save become permanently insane, continuously using confusion behavior: each turn roll d%—01–10 attack the caster, 11–20 act normally, 21–50 babble incoherently, 51–70 flee the caster at top speed, 71–100 attack the nearest creature; a confused creature attacked by someone attacks that creature on its next turn. Remove curse cannot end the insanity, but greater restoration, heal, limited wish, miracle, or wish can. The rune can use the normal symbol trigger conditions, passwords, creature attunements, and permanency interaction, and a rogue can locate and disable it at the source-appropriate high DC. Material component: mercury and phosphorus plus powdered diamond and opal totaling at least 5,000 gp as specified by this printing.

spells/tenacious-dispelling-772.effectSummary: The first casting functions as a targeted dispel magic. Make dispel checks of 1d20 + caster level, maximum +10, against DC 11 + each effect's caster level to end ongoing spells on the target; the targeted form can also suppress a magic item's properties for 1d4 rounds or dispel an ongoing summoned effect under the normal dispel rules. spells/vision-of-the-omniscient-eye-1061.name: Vision of the Omniscient Eye
spells/vision-of-the-omniscient-eye-1061.effectSummary: For 1 minute/level you gain a +10 insight bonus on Spot checks, cannot be dazzled or blinded, and can see normally even if you were already dazzled or blinded when the spell was cast. If you cast it while an effect such as see invisibility or true seeing is active, you can as a swift action mark one invisible creature or object within 60 feet with faerie fire for 1 minute; doing so immediately ends Vision of the Omniscient Eye. The faerie-fire outline removes concealment from ordinary darkness, blur, displacement, and invisibility, but does not overcome concealment from second-level-or-higher magical darkness. A character who learns this spell gains the permanent competence bonus on Spot checks stated by the source.

spells/weighed-in-the-balance-4767.effectSummary: Creatures in a 30-foot-radius area are affected according to alignment. Living creatures of the four extreme alignments—lawful good, chaotic good, lawful evil, chaotic evil—take damage as inflict critical wounds: 4d8 +1 per caster level, maximum +20. Living creatures with one neutral component—neutral good, lawful neutral, chaotic neutral, or neutral evil—take damage as inflict moderate wounds: 2d8 +1 per caster level, maximum +10. True neutral living creatures are healed as by heal, restoring 10 hit points per caster level to a maximum of 150 and curing ability damage, blindness, confusion, dazing, dazzling, deafness, disease, exhaustion, fatigue, feeblemindedness, insanity, nausea, sickness, stunning, and poison, but not negative levels or permanent ability drain. spells/invisibility-swift-3921.name: Invisibility, Swift
spells/invisibility-swift-3921.effectSummary: You become invisible, together with carried gear, as with invisibility, but the spell is personal, cast as a swift action, and lasts only 1 round. It can still end earlier if you attack under ordinary invisibility's attack-breaking rule. While invisible, the normal concealment, equipment, detection-clue, and combat modifiers of invisibility apply.
spells/invisibility-swift-3921.notes: Spell Compendium printing, digest-locked and preserved independently. Its personal swift-action, 1-round form inherits ordinary Invisibility's break-on-attack and visibility mechanics.
